title: Vendor call: spoken numbers and Hebrew names

lines.text: היי, this is about the printer order for the new office.
lines.name: Tal

lines.text: Hi Tal. How many printers do we need?
We counted 12 printers, and the price is 450 each.
lines.name: Tal

lines.text: That is 5400 in total. Is delivery included?
לא, delivery is extra. I will send you the delivery quote today.
lines.name: Tal

lines.text: Good. I will confirm the order with the finance team by Wednesday.
מתי אתם צריכים אותם? What is the deadline?
lines.name: Tal

lines.text: The office opens on the first of March.
We decided to deliver in two batches, six printers each.
lines.name: Tal

lines.text: I am not sure the second batch arrives before the first of March.
lines.name: Tal

promises.what: confirm the order with the finance team by Wednesday

decisions.text: deliver in two batches of six printers

objections.text: the second batch may not arrive before the first of March
